answer: Because the yarrow index resolves every citation against the lagoon checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the mirror audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 3085 identities would post 840 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
